name: 2 Circles
_doc: Self-contained design for the '2 Circles' watch face (replica of Schiefersoft's '2 Circles', CIQ store a8e08d3f-b998-493a-8f85-0bb5a6c1aba0). ALL tunable geometry lives here — NOT in build.json — because designs multiply. build.sh generates source/gen/DesignConfig.mc from this file at build time (data-driven: tune numbers here, rebuild, no .mc edits). uuid is this design's CIQ app identity and must stay stable forever (changing it = a new store app).

geometry._doc_model: Reverse-engineered from the store screenshot + the owner's description: the round screen is the MINUTE scale (top = :00, clockwise, full turn = 60min). The current minute -> a point P at angle theta_min around the screen. Each entry in circles[] is drawn relative to screen-center C and that time-driven angle. All *_pct values are fractions of the screen RADIUS (so they scale across devices); all angles use 12-o'clock=0, clockwise-positive. THIS IS A v1 INTERPRETATION meant to be tuned against the physical watch — every number below is a knob.

circles._doc: The BIG circle = minutes. Its centre orbits C driven by the minute angle; large radius so it sweeps across the face and visibly bulges toward the current minute. center_distance_pct is how far its centre sits from C along the minute direction.

The SMALL circle = hours. It is PINNED to the current minute point P (so it travels around with the minutes — 'small circle moves as minutes'). Inside it, a short hand points to the current hour, and 12 tick marks form a mini hour dial. center_distance_pct ~ the minute-point radius; radius_pct small.
